description: A single front door for employee requests. Every message is routed to the team that has to act on it: IT, Information Security, HR, Facilities or Finance.

categories.name: IT Support
categories.description: Problems with, or requests for, company technology that do not put data at risk: devices, business software, network connectivity, email and collaboration tools, system accounts and printers.

subcategories.name: Hardware
subcategories.description: Company laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, keyboards, mice, headsets and mobile phones: faults, damage, replacements and new equipment.

subcategories.name: Software
subcategories.description: Installing, licensing, updating or fixing business applications other than email and Teams, including applications owned by other departments (such as the expense or HR system) when the application itself is malfunctioning.

subcategories.name: Network
subcategories.description: Wi-Fi, wired network, VPN and internet connectivity, including slow or dropping connections.

subcategories.name: Email & Collaboration
subcategories.description: Outlook, mailboxes, calendars, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive sync problems.

subcategories.name: Accounts & Access
subcategories.description: Password resets, account lockouts, MFA setup, new system accounts and permission requests for applications, folders or shared drives.

subcategories.name: Printing
subcategories.description: Printers, scanners and copiers: jams, toner, print queues and printer setup.

categories.name: Information Security
categories.description: Events that could put company data, accounts or systems at risk, and questions about security rules.

subcategories.name: Phishing & Suspicious Email
subcategories.description: Suspicious emails, messages or calls trying to obtain credentials, money or data, whether or not the employee interacted with them.

subcategories.name: Malware & Virus
subcategories.description: Antivirus alerts, suspected viruses or ransomware, and unexpected software behaviour that suggests an infection.

subcategories.name: Account Compromise
subcategories.description: Signs that someone else is using an account: credentials entered on a suspicious site, MFA prompts the employee did not trigger, unknown sign-ins, files changed or deleted by someone else.

subcategories.name: Lost or Stolen Device
subcategories.description: Lost or stolen company laptops, phones, tablets or storage media.

subcategories.name: Data Exposure
subcategories.description: Sensitive data sent to the wrong recipient, shared publicly or accessed without authorisation.

subcategories.name: Security Policy Question
subcategories.description: Questions about security rules: approved tools, USB drives, password policy, data classification.

categories.name: HR
categories.description: Employment, pay, leave, benefits and workplace conduct.

subcategories.name: Payroll
subcategories.description: Salary, overtime, deductions, payslips, tax forms, and missing or incorrect pay.

subcategories.name: Leave & Time Off
subcategories.description: Vacation balances, sick leave, parental leave and leave requests.

subcategories.name: Benefits
subcategories.description: Health, dental, pension and other benefit plans, and enrolment.

subcategories.name: Onboarding & Offboarding
subcategories.description: The employment process for joiners, movers and leavers: contracts, start dates, payroll records and the overall readiness of a new hire.

subcategories.name: Employee Relations
subcategories.description: Harassment, discrimination, bullying, grievances and conflicts with colleagues or managers.

subcategories.name: HR Policy & Documents
subcategories.description: HR policies and employment documents: employment verification letters, contract copies, handbook questions.

categories.name: Facilities
categories.description: The physical workplace: buildings, physical access, maintenance, furniture, safety and office services.

subcategories.name: Building Access & Badges
subcategories.description: Access badges, door readers, building entry, parking gates and visitor access.

subcategories.name: Maintenance & Repairs
subcategories.description: Heating, air conditioning, lighting, plumbing, leaks, broken doors and other building repairs.

subcategories.name: Workspace & Furniture
subcategories.description: Desks, chairs, ergonomic equipment, desk moves and meeting room setup.

subcategories.name: Health & Safety
subcategories.description: Fire, smoke, gas smells, electrical hazards, injuries, spills and anything else that could hurt someone.

subcategories.name: Office Services
subcategories.description: Kitchens and coffee machines, cleaning, office supplies, mail and deliveries.

categories.name: Finance
categories.description: Company money: expenses, purchasing, supplier payments and corporate cards.

subcategories.name: Expenses & Reimbursement
subcategories.description: Expense claims, reimbursement status and expense policy questions.

subcategories.name: Purchase Orders
subcategories.description: Requests to raise, change or approve purchase orders and purchase requisitions.

subcategories.name: Invoices & Vendor Payments
subcategories.description: Supplier invoices, payment status and vendor payment issues.

subcategories.name: Corporate Card
subcategories.description: Company credit cards: declines, limits, lost cards and card statements.

categories.name: Unclassified
categories.description: Use only when the message cannot be routed to any team above.

subcategories.name: Needs Clarification
subcategories.description: Too vague, incomplete or garbled to route; a follow-up question is needed.

subcategories.name: Out of Scope
subcategories.description: Not a workplace service request: general knowledge, personal errands, chit-chat.

subcategories.name: Non-Actionable
subcategories.description: Nothing to act on: thank-you notes, FYIs, auto-replies, spam.

priorities.description: Immediate danger to people; a confirmed security compromise in progress (someone else using an account, credentials entered on a phishing site, spreading malware, sensitive data confirmed exposed outside the company); or an outage stopping many people, a whole team or site, or a business-critical system.

One person or a small group fully blocked with no workaround; a hard deadline within about 24 hours; or serious exposure such as a lost or stolen device, pay not received, a harassment or discrimination report, or a supplier threatening to stop service.
Work is degraded or inconvenient but a workaround exists; standard requests needed within days; contained security events (a phishing email reported but not clicked, malware already quarantined).
Questions, how-tos, information requests, cosmetic issues and requests with no near-term deadline.

disambiguation_rules: Route to the team that must act to resolve the request. A malfunctioning application is IT Support / Software even when another department owns the process: the expense tool crashing is IT Support, a question about what can be expensed is Finance.

Anything that may put company data or accounts at risk is Information Security, even when hardware or access is involved: a lost laptop is Information Security / Lost or Stolen Device, not IT Support / Hardware.
Physical access (badges, doors, gates) is Facilities; access to systems, applications or files is IT Support / Accounts & Access.
Fire, smoke, gas, electrical hazards, injuries or other danger to people is always Facilities / Health & Safety at Critical priority, however casually it is described.

New joiners and leavers: use HR / Onboarding & Offboarding when the employment process is involved (contracts, start dates, payroll records), even if equipment or accounts are also missing, and list IT Support as a secondary category. Use IT Support alone when the request is only about equipment or accounts.

Computer peripherals (keyboards, mice, monitors, headsets) are IT Support / Hardware; furniture and ergonomics are Facilities / Workspace & Furniture; consumables and supplies are Facilities / Office Services.
If a message contains several requests, classify it by the most severe or urgent one and list the other teams in secondary_categories.
